heroHeadline: Day 4,870: SK Military Exemption Policy Under Review
heroSubtitle: October 13, 2026 is Day 4,870 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. South Korea's military exemption framework faces political scrutiny after soccer players' public boasting — the same system governing BTS members' service status.
